soundness_flags.label: prop:no-attrition-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: With k=0 the completion set is a singleton, so the proposition is a pure unfolding of def:completion-set and def:robust-pvalue rather than a substantive solve target.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.2, equation (2), lines 103-110; Section 4.2, equations (7)-(8), lines 177-197; Theorem 1, lines 238-251
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses completely randomized/exchangeable assignments, rank statistics with an ordering-based tie breaker, and a valid worst-case sharp-null p-value under its general missingness assumption.
The paper bounds ordinary two-sample Wilcoxon statistics/p-values under arbitrary missing values and extends its analysis to tied observations using midranks.
The paper treats exchangeable assignments and rank-score statistics with random ordering-based tie breaking, obtaining closed-form optimization for bounded-null/quantile inference.
The article gives an efficient recursive algorithm for exact permutational distributions of linear rank statistics under restricted sequential randomization rules.
